title: SvelteKit
notes: SvelteKit built with Vite and adapter-node, as its deployment guide says. Only the API route is measured: the pages cannot pass the shared checks (see details).
details: Built with vite build and @sveltejs/adapter-node; the build/index.js entry, which `node build` runs, is imported into the measured process, on Bun and Deno as on Node. It listens as soon as it is imported, so it is given PORT=0 and HOST=127.0.0.1 and the port is read from the http server it exports. The API route is a +server.js handler returning json(). adapter-node's defaults are kept. The static and dynamic pages were left out: adapter-node answers a prerendered page without a Content-Type header, and Svelte writes > in text unescaped, which the shared page check does not accept.
